name: money-surfaces-visual
description: Redesign P5: Contracts, Finances, and Operations panels rendered with real state — a blasted plan (spend + fragments + logistics), one negotiated offer, one accepted contract, and a shift-policy change. Plan origin (5,5), not (10,10): see blast-workshop-french-visual.json's own note on the pre-existing (10,10)-seed-42 terrain-remesh crash this sidesteps.

steps.description: Setup: a small blasted plan (spend + fragments for Finances/Operations), then two contract offers — one negotiated (left in Offered, for the inline result), one accepted (moved to Active)

interaction.command: drill_plan grid origin:5,5 rows:2 cols:2 spacing:3 depth:6

steps.description: Contracts panel: storage strip, one active card, offered cards with the negotiate result inline on #1
Finances panel: real balance/trend/runway, category bars from the blast spend, ledger — opened via the TopBar balance click, not a rail button
Operations panel: logistics rows from the blast's fragments, empty ore-on-hand/incidents states, site policy card
Operations panel: clicking a shift pill and Apply is a real, clickable interaction — pill highlight updates, note text changes, Apply dispatches set_policy
